name: Ueji Yayoi
source:
Cup size: None

Ayano's classmate and a famous occult enthusiast.
Yayoi seems indifferent about most things and doesn't show many emotions.
However, she immediately becomes talkative about her knowledge when occultism is involved.
She has no interest in romantic affairs as occultism takes all of her commitment.
